svg.title: ARMOR-DOCS architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-DOCS holds the architecture, the security baseline, the threat model and the capability matrix, and the tools that write from one source the README of every repository in eight languages, the catalogue of versions, the banners and icons, the copies of the CI checks, and that look for anything private before a publication. Versions and maturity are read from each repository's own manifest, so a README cannot say something else.
